invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of bulkInsert, which should not be null.
The parallelism (numOutputGroups) for clustering should always be greater than zero.
Clustering is performed only when there are input records to cluster.
fileGroupIdList is a required input to clustering and should not be null.
Each WriteStatus in result typically corresponds to a group of input records, so the number of WriteStatus entries cannot exceed the total number of input records.
